name: CST
comment: Caret-Separated Text, as the CST specification describes it: comments, keys, values between carets that may run across lines, placeholders, and references.

patterns.comment: A key, then its value. A key on its own line, above its value, is a key too.
A reference to another table's text: U+0002, then <cst>…</cst>.
patterns.name: keyword.control.reference.cst

patterns.comment: The placeholders the specification lists: %s, %d, %i, %u, %ld, %02d, %.2d, %3d, and %% for a percent sign.
patterns.name: constant.character.format.placeholder.cst
